set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login class [parameter1].explanation: This Junos command fragment defines a login class named `[parameter1]`, specifying permissions and access levels for users assigned to this class.

parameters.name: class-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the login class.

authentication-order [parameter2].explanation: Sets the order of authentication methods for user login, prioritizing `[parameter2]` (e.g., `radius`, `tacplus`, or `password`) as the first method to be used.

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: Order of authentication, for example, Radius.
